description: Read replies, bounces, unsubscribes, meetings booked, interest changes, and LinkedIn replies from your own Instantly, Smartlead, HeyReach, and lemlist accounts for a time window. Returns one flat row per event (vendor, event type, time, lead email and name, company, campaign, reply text where the vendor returns it) plus one free run summary row with counts and the status of each vendor. Vendor keys are read from this server's environment (INSTANTLY_API_KEY, SMARTLEAD_API_KEY, HEYREACH_API_KEY, LEMLIST_API_KEY); vendors with no key are skipped. Read-only: it never creates, edits, pauses, or sends anything in a sequencer. A run that does not succeed is returned as an error with its run ID. Requires an APIFY_TOKEN and is billed per event row.

event_types.description: Which events to return. Default: reply, linkedin_reply, bounce, unsubscribe, meeting_booked, interested, connection_accepted.

heyreach_campaign_ids.description: Read only these HeyReach campaigns (numeric ids). Empty: all campaigns.

instantly_campaign_ids.description: Read only these Instantly campaigns (UUIDs). Empty: all campaigns.

lemlist_campaign_ids.description: Read only these lemlist campaigns (cam_ ids). Empty: all campaigns.

max_charge_usd.description: Optional. The run stops before a charge that would pass this amount.

max_events.description: Event rows per run, oldest first. Default 5000.

max_pages_per_query.description: Pages of 100 records per vendor query. Default 20.

only_new.description: Skip events an earlier run already returned (free). Default true.

since.description: Optional start of the window in UTC, for example 2026-10-20T00:00:00Z.

since_hours.description: Read events from this many hours before the run, at most 2160 (90 days). Default 24. Ignored when since is set.

smartlead_campaign_ids.description: Read only these Smartlead campaigns. Empty: all non draft campaigns.

state_key.description: Optional name for the only new events memory, so two schedules keep separate memories.

until.description: Optional end of the window in UTC. Default now.

name: poll_sequencer_events
title: Poll sequencer events
